title: ALMA Observations of the Debris Disk of Solar Analog τ Ceti
question: Where is the inner edge and how wide is the tau Ceti debris belt at 1.3 mm, what does that imply for the proposed five-planet system, and what is the origin of the unresolved central source?

data.arrays: ALMA 12-m array (34 antennas) plus ACA (11 antennas)

what.value: Inclination 35±10 deg and PA 105±10 deg from Herschel models, assumed for belt

evidence.quote: we assume that the millimeter belt emission is described by the same geometry.

what.value: 850 um flux 5.8±0.6 mJy and 55 AU radius from SCUBA

evidence.quote: obtain a total flux density at 850 $\mu$m for the disk of $5.8\pm0.6$ mJy

what.value: Debris disk spectral index 2.58 used to extrapolate 850 um flux to 1.3 mm (1.2±0.2 mJy)

evidence.quote: using the typical spectral index of 2.58 for debris disks at (sub)millimeter wavelengths (cite: gas12)

what.value: VLA 8.7 mm flux 25.3±3.9 uJy and 2 cm upper limit

evidence.quote: At 8.7 mm, the measured flux density is $25.3\pm3.9$ $\mu$Jy

recipe.goal: Image continuum and separate star from disk
recipe.method: CLEAN with natural weights and 6'' taper; uvsub point-source subtraction for disk; baselines >40 klambda untapered for star

recipe.goal: Fit parametric belt plus point source to 12-m visibilities
recipe.method: Thin axisymmetric belt with power-law surface density, model visibilities via python uvmodel implementation, multiplied by Gaussian primary beam, MCMC fit
key_parameters: Free: Rin, Rout, Fbelt, Fcen, gamma; Rout <= 55 AU; gamma in -4 to 4; uniform priors
assumptions: T ∝ r^-0.5 blackbody; i=35 deg, PA=105 deg from Herschel; no offsets fitted

recipe.goal: Derive belt width and stellar brightness temperature and spectral index
recipe.method: Fractional width from Rin and Rout; Planck brightness temperature at 1.3 mm, 8.7 mm, 2 cm; spectral index between 1.3 and 8.7 mm
assumptions: Photospheric radius at mm/cm equals optical value 0.793 Rsun

evidence.quote: The best-fit total belt flux density is $F_\text{belt} = 1.0^{+0.6}_{-0.4}$ mJy

answer_key.quantity: Central source flux density at 1.3 mm

evidence.quote: with a flux density of $0.69^{+0.02}_{-0.05}$ mJy

evidence.loc: 4.1 Location of the Disk Inner Edge and Belt Width
evidence.quote: the fractional width of the $\tau$ Ceti disk is $\Delta R/R = 1.6^{+0.3}_{-0.6}$
